title: alyans bi invite yàqu-yàqu
intro: Xalaatal suñu nekkee ci suufu benn kër ak feeñu, waaye tànn loyalite bu wuute. Nit kooku nekkoon na lu jege dëgg ak yonent, waaye dafa wëlbatiku ci ñi ko bañ. Seen jaar-jaar dafay àrtu bu baax ni jege njub kese mënul muccal ruuh bu wor ngëm.
clues: Dëkk naa ci këru yonent bu Yàlla tànn.
Xamoon naa dëgg gi sama jëkkër doon waare, waaye gëmu ma ko dëgg.
Maa ngi weddi kooluteem ndax maa ngi nekkoon ci wetu nit ñi mu bañ, jàppale leen ñu xeex ak moom.
Dañu ma wax ci wetu jabar bu beneen yonent bu wor, muy misaal ci ñi gëmul.
Sama jaar-jaar ñu ngi ko nettali ci Surah At-Tahrim ngir artu ni mbokk ak yonent yi amul benn kaaraange.
Maa ngi sànku ak tooñkat ya bi Yàlla tasee waa Luutut, bàyyi leen ci ginnaaw ña fa desoon.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
